Method.name: CopyToTpFromJSON
Method.Implementation:
Set cm.Name=obj.Name set cm.ContactEmail = obj.ContactEmail Set cm.ContactName = obj.ContactName set cm.ContactPhone = obj.ContactPhone set cm.Type = obj.Type set cm.LastmodID = obj.User set cm.CreateID = obj.User if (cm.Type = "") { set cm.Type = obj.TPtype }
